description: C + 1 real submissions in one epoch. The tree refuses more than C leaves; the batcher never asks it to, and queues the excess instead.

tree_asked_to_build_c_plus_one.source: TCU-02 §4.3, checked against the engine at generation time

notes: The batcher's key is RFC 8032 §7.1's published specification test key, not a real one. Its private half is public, so every promise here is reproducible, and no real batcher key exists anywhere in this repository: the engine has no place to keep one.

The master key is a specification test key, not a real one: its bytes spell out what it is. Every epoch key, slot and padding leaf here follows from it, so the whole tree is reproducible. A real k_master never appears in this repository (INV-TREE-05).
Two layers answer this row. The tree returns 0x12 when asked to build past capacity; the batcher queues instead and promises the next epoch it can meet, so nothing is dropped (D-71).
